text:
Maya R.: quick sync — OmniEdge wants a joint POC next week. they need an enablement checklist and a clear ask list from our side.
Sam K.: timeline? are they expecting Dedicated or hosted API during pilot?
Devon (partner-eng): OmniEdge asked for dedicated perf numbers and SSO, but they can start on hosted if we can guarantee 99th p50 latency targets. also need KV-cache behavior doc.
Maya R.: target start Tue 10am PT. we should confirm model variant and batching plan; partner cares about cost vs latency tradeoffs.
Alberto V.: for perf numbers i'll propose: rtx-a10 pool, 8k context, dynamic batching @ 8-12ms avg token. rough pricing for co-sell POC: $X/day — will pull exact from pricing table.
Sarah-SE: security asks: they want SOC2 scope, egress IP list, where logs are stored, and answers to the standard questionnaire (I can attach template). also need confirmation on KMS/HSM for Private deploys.
Devon (partner-eng): OmniEdge will run some network-level tests — need egress CIDRs and a small nginx sample to test latency. tagging them for networking review.
Alberto V.: nginx sample for simple proxy + keepalive:

```
proxy_pass http://redwood-hosted:443;
proxy_set_header Connection "";
proxy_http_version 1.1;
keepalive_timeout 65;
```

Use this with a small wrk script to simulate streaming tokens.
Sam K.: can we give them a softened SLO during POC? like retry policy + fallback to smaller model if capacity spikes?
Maya R.: yes — plan: primary -> rtx-a10 hosted; fallback -> 4-gpu quant model (faster lower-cost). document will include routing policy & canary steps.
Sarah-SE: sending questionnaire now. Devon, can you get egress CIDRs by EOD? I need them for the vendor security sheet.
Devon (partner-eng): on it. i'll ping infra and share CIDR list and a short runbook for connecting.
deploy-bot: deployment requested: create temporary piloter-omniedge cluster, expires in 14 days.
Maya R.: action items: (1) Alberto — finalize perf estimate + sample wrk script (2) Sam — pricing note for co-sell POC + softened SLO wording (3) Devon — CIDRs + runbook (4) Sarah — send questionnaire to OmniEdge. meet Tue 9am PT to hand off. :thumbsup:
Sam K.: ack. I'll try to get the pricing delta by EOD so we can prep the customer-facing sheet.
Maya R.: thanks all — let's keep threads lightweight here. adding OmniEdge contact: @kevin-omniedge to the next invite when we have agenda.
